modeOn: Writing mode: pen writes, fingers pan. Exit to edit by touch
confirmClear: Clear all strokes on this document? You can still undo afterwards.
exportPdfHint: Load the complete document, including folded/unloaded content, into an image PDF at the current width. SQL embeds and references use SiYuan's static export. The generated PDF is downloaded by the browser, not uploaded to the server.
exportBestEffortHint: On by default: unsupported content uses compatible text/placeholders and a report. Ink that cannot be reliably placed goes in a separate appendix. Turn off for strict validation. Security, access and resource limits remain enforced.
exportPdfReadyWarnings: PDF ready: {pages} pages, {count} compatibility notes. Review the export report
exportMathText: A formula was exported as source text
exportMissingImage: An unavailable image was replaced by a placeholder
exportUnsafeResource: An unsafe resource reference was removed
exportStaticEmbed: SQL embed {id} is a static native export; query/export limits may apply
exportUnverifiedEmbed: SQL embed {id}: native static output was retained, but its exact mapping/results could not be verified (empty, filtered or limited results are possible)
exportStaticReference: Block references use SiYuan's static export representation
exportMissingBlock: Block {id} was not preserved by the native export; its content could not be verified
exportOverflowText: Clipped or oversized content was converted to wrapped text
exportEmbedInkUncertain: SQL embeds and older block-ID-only ink do not carry historical instance identity; ink is shown separately to avoid attaching it to the wrong occurrence. Original ink in the note is unchanged
exportUnplacedInk: {count} strokes could not be safely attached to the exported content; thumbnail copies follow
exportInkAppendix: Unplaced ink preview — not its document position
exportPreviewLimited: Preview limit reached; use the JSON backup for full data
exportMoreWarnings: Further compatibility details are shown by placeholders in the document.
exportPdfDownloadStarted: PDF download requested from your browser
exportPdfReady: PDF ready: {pages} pages. Click Download PDF
exportPreparing: Preparing the full document and its resources…
exportAlreadyRunning: Another export is running. Wait for it or cancel it first
exportBackupHint: Save currently loaded sync data and unsaved edits for recovery. May include saved deletion before-images; keep it private. This does not certify that unloaded remote data has synchronized.
exportInkDesc: Export ink without the document. Save to SiYuan assets and optionally insert into the note.
exportNone: No strokes on this document yet
exportInserted: Image inserted at the end of the document
saveRetry: Ink is retained in this session and saving will retry; keep this page open until connectivity returns
syncMerged: Synchronized handwriting changes from other devices
syncConflicts: Concurrent edits were kept as separate ink copies. Move or delete unwanted copies individually
syncImportLegacyConfirm: Refresh all old browser/PWA pages first. This preserves the original file and only adds new or changed legacy ink. Missing values do not delete current ink; conflicts remain separate copies. Merge now?
syncImportLegacyDone: Legacy handwriting merged safely; editing can continue
syncBlocked: Handwriting sync paused: {msg}. Keep this page open; undo unsaved edits or download a JSON backup from Export.
syncCleanupFailed: Ink saved, but older snapshot cleanup failed. Files were retained
documentDeletionPending: Checking a document deletion notice; old ink writes are paused
documentDeletionConfirm: Document {id} may have been restored, or a notebook may be closed/locked. This deletion notice cannot be assigned to a lifetime with certainty. Permanently clear the current ink generation, including any new ink written after restoration? Cancel keeps the unconfirmed data. This cannot be undone.
documentCleanupFailed: Handwriting cleanup for {id} is incomplete; remaining files were kept. Keep this page open. Reconnecting or returning to it will retry and request confirmation when needed.
settingShowFloatingBallHint: When hidden, use the desktop top bar or command to toggle drawing; on mobile, restore the button in plugin settings
settingMouseDrawingHint: Off: the mouse edits while the stylus draws. If a tablet driver reports only mouse events, enable Windows Ink/pen mode first, or enable this fallback (the browser cannot distinguish that tablet from a real mouse)
settingDoubleTapHint: Quickly tap the page twice with the stylus, not the pen barrel. Disable when writing dots or punctuation
settingPenWidthMaxHint: Maximum of the width slider on the toolbar; default 20
settingShapeSnapHint: Pause briefly after drawing a line, rectangle, triangle or ellipse and it snaps to a perfect shape (GoodNotes-style); move again to keep drawing freehand
